description: This is a shell script file containing test cases and setup for testing 'git reset' command behavior with options '--merge' and '--keep'. It includes definitions of test scenarios, setup commands, and checks to verify correct functioning of git reset under various conditions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a description and commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test tick (timestamp or commit expiration).

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a file path is missing.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a file path exists and is a file.

methods.name: test_diff --exit-code
methods.description: Checks if there are differences between files or branches, exits with appropriate status.
